correctness.rationale: Complete proof: rational mechanical words are primitive cyclic orbits; monotone phase ordering gives individual BWT 1^k0^(n-k); no-11 forces original first-half points below 1/3 and reflected ones above 1/3; reflection flips and reverses predecessor digits; exact six-block label word has five jumps. Exact rational tests on 170 fractions agree but are not used to establish the infinite statement.

value.rationale: Complete exact classification of the minimal flower cost for the canonical reflection-symmetric union of any two complementary rational Sturmian orbits: uniformly five despite each component separately fitting one petal, with sharp exceptions at the reflection-fixed slopes. Distinguishes joint invariant support complexity from componentwise minimality, relevant to multi-measure flower support in ergodic optimization and symbolic dynamics, and provides an explicit six-block structural mechanism over unbounded denominators.
